name: svf
summary: Chamberlin state-variable filter with a selectable output (LP/BP/HP), a bypass, and a cutoff envelope. `f` = 2*sin(pi*fc/fs) (Q16), `q` = damping (Q16); `type` 0=LP 1=BP 2=HP picks `out`; `on` 0 = bypass (out = input); `fenv` (control, Q15) scales `fenv_depth` (Q16) and is added to `f`, so a note-gated envelope opens/closes the cutoff. Bipolar `k` (key-follow) and `vk` (velocity-follow) factors (Q15) push `f` toward 0/65535 (block-derived `f_eff`).
